mentions.name: Teletest
mentions.description: This service lets patients in Canada easily order bloodwork and lab testing online, bringing the convenient lab-testing experience available in the USA to Canada and improving the overall patient healthcare experience.
mentions.problem: Ordering bloodwork and lab testing in Canada is difficult compared to the easy experience available in the USA.
mentions.source_excerpt:
One thing I liked about the USA was how easy it was to order bloodwork/lab testing. My original idea was to bring that experience to Canada, but since starting I've found other ways to improve the patient healthcare experience in Canada too.

My company is https://teletest.ca
